description: Flood in Libya (2023-09-11) is a hazard data set listed in DataCite country sweep of research-data repositories (Africa), a research data metadata index, published or maintained by European Commission, Joint Research Centre. Coverage: Libya. The portal files it under the publisher European Commission, Joint Research Centre. Its tags are Regions and cities, Environment, Coastal flood, Copernicus, EMSR696. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening for infrastructure. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-africa-dc-portal.
